name: Typorium
description: A Typora-style WYSIWYG Markdown editor for the web. Your documents stay on your device.

paragraphs: Typorium is a Typora-style WYSIWYG Markdown editor that runs in the browser and installs as a Progressive Web App. You type Markdown and it turns into formatted text as you go. When the cursor touches a formatted element, its Markdown syntax appears so you can edit it. Your documents are ordinary .md files.
It runs on desktop browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox) and on iPadOS, where it adds a touch formatting bar above the on-screen keyboard and works offline once installed to the Home Screen.
Typorium is an independent project and is not affiliated with Typora.
features: Typorium aims to match Typora's behaviour and file format. Documents written in either app open in the other.

Headings, emphasis, strong, strikethrough, ==highlight==, sub, ^sup^, underline, , inline code, links, reference links, autolinks, images, emoji shortcodes, footnotes, inline HTML and HTML blocks. Syntax is hidden until…
Enter starts a new paragraph and Shift+Enter adds a line break.
